[[File:CSFvehicles.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Police speeders on Coruscant]]
A '''police speeder''', also called a '''police cruiser''' or '''police skimmer''', was the name for an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] utilized by a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] to perform patrol duties.

The police force may have used various models of speeders for police functions. Some may have been marked, others were unmarked depending on the needs of the [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] who piloted them. Police speeders may have had a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and passenger compartment with possibility for transporting prisoners or may have been in the form of a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] allowing for only one officer.

The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] utilized a variety of police speeders to patrol the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], they notably utilized the [[Coruscant police speeder/Legends|Coruscant police speeder]] and the [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|RapidResponse police speeder]].
